items.title: Creepy Faces
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Scare your friends with these creepy faces! Are you ready to become a monster hiding in the dark?

+Horror skins!
+Amazing for roleplay!

items.title: Kawaii School Diaries
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Dress fashionably for school with these cute teen outfits inspired by anime! You're sure to be the most kawaii player with one of these colorful outfits.

+ Includes 12 skins
+ 1 FREE skin!
+ By Yeggs

items.title: Reed Smart: AI Detective
items.creator: Minecraft
items.description: Join Detective Reed Smart to investigate curious cases of AI misuse in this mystery from Minecraft Education! Analyze deepfakes, spot AI-generated content, and learn how AI works as you follow clues and analyze evidence across three cases. Build AI and information literacy skills that will help you get wise and stay cautious of online information. Ready to crack the case?

items.title: Love Hues
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Immerse yourself in a romantic atmosphere with this amazing pack! Explore a selection of stylish looks in vibrant shades of red, pink, and black. Perfect for celebrating special occasions or simply standing out with charm!

+ 12 epic skins
+ Made by Square Studios, published by Waypoint Studios.

items.title: Spellswords Add-On
items.creator: King Cube
items.description:
Ever wondered what happens when you merge spells with swords? Find out in the “Spellswords” Add-On. a groundbreaking weapon Add-On with a magical twist!
+ Discover unique magical weapons.
+ 136 craftable combinations!
+ Includes Dual-wield and Double-sided swords.

WATCH THE Spellswords Add-On TRAILER!

items.title: Aphmau's Ninja Warriors
items.creator: CatFace
items.description:
Sneak through the shadows in style with Aphmau's Ninja Warrior Skin Pack! Sharpen your stealth skills while representing your favorite Aphmau character in one of these 12 epic skins!

+2 Aaron Skins
+2 Aphmau Skins
+2 KC, Kim, Pierce, and Zane Skins!

items.title: Epic Buddies
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Step into luxury! Deck out your crew in sleek suits, sparkling dresses, and fancy accessories. From fancy parties to epic adventures, stand out in style with these ultra-cool skins. Upgrade your look now!

+ 1 Free Skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Medieval jobs
items.creator: Impress
items.description:
Feel the passage of time with skins themed around real medieval professions!

- Most 41 characters feature unique designs
- Lightly emphasized for better usability
- You're bound to find your favorite!

Creator: Melina

items.title: Superman
items.creator: Oreville Studios
items.description: It’s a pig, it’s a plane, it’s the Superman DLC! Play as Superman himself and use powers like Super Strength, Heat Vision, and Super-Breath to take down villains and protect Metropolis. Fly to the Fortress of Solitude and hang out with Krypto.

items.title: Force Items Challenge
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
A challenge with simple rules: collect items in a set sequence. Sounds easy? It’s harder than you think. Start in any world or seed, each attempt is different!

- Across all dimensions!
- 6 exciting structures to discover.
- Get cool prizes if you succeed...

Endless possibilities every time you play!

items.title: Villagers Assemble
items.creator: DigiPort
items.description:
Villagers assemble! Put on these villager skins and get ready to destroy those pesky pillager towers. Join us and fight with us in this epic adventure.

• 9 skins
• Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Robots Add-On
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Upgrade your productivity with Robots! Create automated farms and mines. Battle your robots with your friends. Keep yourself safe from monsters with turrets and bodyguards.
+ 7 new upgradeable robots
+ Hovercraft vehicle and Mechanic trader
+ By Yeggs

items.title: Spider VS Venom 2
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description: Choose your side, will you be good or evil?! If you loved the last pack, you'll adore this one! Stop Venoms or become one of them, you decide the city's fate!

items.title: Alien Parkour
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Aliens have arrived! Parkour your way through this exciting ecosystem and find your way to the spaceship! Beam up!

- Many Alien-themed challenges!
- Perfect with friends!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Night Horns
items.creator: Mimic
items.description:
Time to emerge from the shadows as a horned nightmare! This collection of skins offers a shadowy range of mysterious horned creatures! Lurk around and pop out at your friends!

• Includes 8 skins!
• Created by Mimic

items.title: Soul Seekers
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Harness the mystical power of souls to enchant your tools and weapons with powerful enchantments and abilities with Giggle Block Studios' "Soul Seekers"!

- Powerful enchantment combinations
- Grow your own souls
- 10 different souls to find

items.title: Dark Hearts
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
When the night falls, make sure you have the right outfits on to defend yourself! These outfits help you blend into the darkness on your nightly hunts. 

- 8 Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios
- Artist: Aagean

items.title: Emotion Squad
items.creator: Lore Studios
items.description:
This might be the best way to show your emotions! Get them now and better express how you feel to your friends.

- 8 Emoted Skins!
- Perfect with friends!
- By Lore Studios

items.title: Pastel Adventures
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Jump into a pastel world where everything looks soft and cute! This pastel texture pack turns your world into a cute and relaxing experience.

- New Expressive 3D look for entities
- Fully custom UI
- 12 unique pastel skins

By Crimson Creative & Pathway Studios

items.title: Void Monsters
items.creator: Skilendarz
items.description:
Born from the darkness between worlds... The Void Monsters skin pack unleashes terrifying creatures from the depths of the unknown. Twisted by chaos and shadow, these beings are the stuff of nightmares.

- 10 terrifying void creature skins!
- Perfect for horror and dark fantasy roleplay!
- Embrace the void... if you dare.

items.title: Beyond Souls
items.creator: Big Dye Gaming
items.description:
Glow with power in the Beyond Souls skin pack! Choose from 10 vibrant, glowing skins like Nebula, Phoenix, and Lunar. Stand out in style and light up your adventures!

+ 10 neon-themed skins
+ Perfect for fun! 

By Big Dye Gaming

items.title: Cityscapes Las Vegas
items.creator: Octovon
items.description:
Explore the dazzling streets of Las Vegas in this immersive city experience, where vibrant nights, themed resorts, and iconic attractions await. Stroll past world-famous buildings, towering hotels, and hidden gems that showcase the city's unique blend of glitz, glamour, and unexpected charm.
- Resorts and hotels
- Interiors in every building
- Iconic Vegas landmarks!

items.title: Ecko Mobs
items.creator: StarkTMA
items.description:
A Bold Collab with EckoSoldier!

• 12 unique skins reimagining classic mobs with an Ecko twist.
• Play as ‘WardenEcko’, ‘EndermanEcko’, ‘SpiderEcko’, and more!
• Each skin blends mob inspiration with signature Ecko style for a fresh, standout look.

items.title: Dark Suits
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Unleash elegance and mystery! This skin pack adds a modern, stylish edge with sleek, dark-toned outfits. Dress your characters in sophisticated looks that impress.
Step up your style and transform your game today.

+ 10 stunning dark-themed skins!
